evidence_items.explanation: This supports inevitability within the authors' formal framework. Their definition concerns disagreement with a prescribed correct output, so applying it to useful systems that can acknowledge uncertainty requires an additional argument.

The paper identifies incentives favoring guesses over uncertainty and proposes evaluation changes. This challenges a blanket architectural explanation but does not demonstrate complete elimination in useful general-purpose operation.
